# MOTOR BIKE GAME - C. Fethers - DREAMER 10 p.23 (PDF p.25)
# load 0080-03FF (printed range 0080-0400); CHIP-8 starts at 0200, run C000 FN 3
# 0080-00E9 = 6800 machine code (key/speed handler), 00EA-00F9 CHIP-8; 00FA-00FF not printed
# (variables, 00 here); screen buffer 0100-01FF not printed (00).
# how to play: motor bike with rider at the bottom; velocity, distance and time at the top.
# D = accelerate, E = brake; change gear by releasing the accelerator briefly; accelerating
# too hard makes the bike ride up on its back wheel (wheelie). Jump the obstacles or crash.
# F ('foot') edges the bike backwards when stopped (only when an obstacle is visible).
# The program stops after 120 miles.
# IRQ vector (0000) is set to 0080 by the CHIP-8 code at 0222-022E; the handler ends with JMP C3E9.
# Note: 0300 = 03DC calls the 6800 code at 03DC (ASRA ASRA ANDA #3F STAA V0); 03DA would also
# load V5 first. Printed as 03DC; both give the same velocity display in the simulation.
# 03B2 F0F0 = deliberate stop (invalid FX op returns to the monitor) after 120 miles.
